title: Short-time existence and uniqueness for two-phase harmonic map heat flow with a prescribed moving interface
summary: Let $N^+$ and $N^-$ be disjoint compact smooth submanifolds of a Euclidean space, and let $Λ\subset N^+\times N^-$ be a compact smooth embedded submanifold prescribing admissible pairs of one-sided traces.
